caption_and_notices.meta_description: New level crossing installation from the factory site of Stadler Rail in Altenrhein to the SBB line. For road users, it looks like a normal traffic light and not like a railroad crossing. But the traffic light shows never green and the yellow flashes when the system is inactive. And the barrier is actually not for the train, but as a blockade for pedestrians which like to take a shortcut there. Staad, Altenrhein, Switzerland, Jan 7, 2015.
